notes.whole_labels_minimized: Macro relief, footprint and regional masks unchanged. Roads are less dominant; this remains provisional campaign art.
notes.ordinary_campaign: Shared alignments and narrower roads reduce clutter. Some parallel stretches and angular junctions still warrant targeted review.
notes.human_roads: Arrivals reach the city and widths are reduced. Distinct branches remain; this is not a claim that every visible near-parallel path is art-approved.
notes.human_capital_approach: Main/coastal arrivals avoid housing and join the open street/forecourt. City scale is unchanged. Exact authored gate/quay and island correspondence remain unresolved.
notes.river_ford: Unbridged shallow crossing, bank curvature and subtle owned bed stones. Native maximum on the crossroads route is 21.76 degrees. Water edges remain provisional ribbons.
notes.major_stone_bridge: Existing major stone span retained with native collision and continuous route approach. Material/abutment art remains provisional.
notes.minor_bridge: The old unused woodland bridge is hidden, with no legal edge removed. A bounded attempt to use it failed the east-bank grade gate.
notes.broken_bridge: Intact stone span replaced by two cut owned stone ends and a narrower timber repair. The crossing reads as repaired ruins; clean cut faces remain provisional.
notes.ferry_landing: The central inlet keeps a ferry passage. Road approaches terminate at fitted shore landings, not inland endpoints or a giant sea bridge.
notes.dwarf_approach: KNOWN DEFECT: the footprint spans about 7.22 m of ground relief. A bounded 16 m bench search did not find a better seat. No terrain pad or hold rescale was made.
notes.mountain_pass: Authored relief retained. Grade-qualified curves still have tight, pathfinder-like turns; turning-radius/roadbed construction is not fully qualified.
notes.orc_routes: Badlands military roads narrowed and local approaches refined. Mesa identity retained. Regional donor/material transition was not changed.
notes.nature_paths: Clearing/Treehold roads share the River Woodland approach. Unused crossing removed. Forest diversity and remaining tight bends are provisional.
notes.close_road: Softer, narrower material footprint. Minor-site base/slope intersections remain, and the road is still a surface mask rather than a constructed roadbed.
notes.minor_timber_bridge: 13 m minor tributary span uses owned Forest_village timber modules. Rails now run parallel to travel; native deck collision is continuous. Support/abutment detail is provisional.
notes.ferry_landing_close: Owned timber jetty and piles meet the shore approach. Ferry boat/service presentation is not implemented on this candidate.
notes.southern_crossing: Routes now enter along the bridge deck axis instead of clipping stone parapets. No terrain changes.
